title: A Qualitative Evaluation of Language Models on Automatic Question-Answering for COVID-19
reasoning: The paper's focus is on the technical performance and relevance of answers generated by language models for COVID-19 questions. While one of the twelve evaluation questions asks about 'ethical and social science considerations', the paper itself does not conduct an evaluation or benchmark of ethics, morals, or faith. The methodology is centered on information accuracy and relevance, not on ethical analysis.
